SELECT run_id, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT diagnostic_seq) AS distinct_n, MIN(diagnostic_seq) AS first_seq, MAX(diagnostic_seq) AS last_seq FROM (SELECT * FROM run_diagnostics UNION ALL SELECT run_id, decision_seq AS diagnostic_seq, ts_utc, instrument_id, 'decision' AS stage, 'recorded' AS outcome, 'decision_recorded' AS reason_code, 'decision_recorded' AS reasons, "target", position_before AS quantity, decision_price AS price, decision_mark_source AS mark_source, decision_mark_age AS mark_age, ts_utc AS decision_ts_utc, NULL::TIMESTAMP AS execution_ts_utc, NULL::INTEGER AS event_seq, "target" AS target_before_risk, "target" AS target_after_risk, position_before, position_before AS position_after, NULL::VARCHAR AS feature_identity_json, '{}' AS detail_json FROM run_diagnostic_implicit UNION ALL SELECT run_id, execution_seq AS diagnostic_seq, ts_utc, instrument_id, 'execution' AS stage, 'filled' AS outcome, '' AS reason_code, '' AS reasons, "target", fill_quantity AS quantity, fill_price AS price, '' AS mark_source, NULL::INTEGER AS mark_age, ts_utc AS decision_ts_utc, execution_ts_utc, event_seq, "target" AS target_before_risk, "target" AS target_after_risk, position_before, position_after, NULL::VARCHAR AS feature_identity_json, '{}' AS detail_json FROM run_diagnostic_implicit WHERE execution_seq IS NOT NULL) logical WHERE run_id IN (?) GROUP BY run_id

SELECT DISTINCT i.run_id FROM run_diagnostic_implicit i JOIN runs r ON r.run_id = i.run_id LEFT JOIN snapshot_bars b ON b.snapshot_id = r.snapshot_id AND b.instrument_id = i.instrument_id AND b.ts_utc = i.ts_utc LEFT JOIN ledger_events e ON e.run_id = i.run_id AND e.event_seq = i.event_seq WHERE i.run_id IN (?) AND (i.decision_mark_source <> 'current_close' OR i.decision_mark_age <> 0 OR b.ts_utc IS NULL OR b.close IS DISTINCT FROM i.decision_price OR (i.execution_seq IS NOT NULL AND (e.event_seq IS NULL OR e.event_type <> 'FILL' OR e.instrument_id IS DISTINCT FROM i.instrument_id OR e.ts_utc IS DISTINCT FROM i.execution_ts_utc OR e.qty IS DISTINCT FROM i.fill_quantity OR e.price IS DISTINCT FROM i.fill_price OR i.position_after IS DISTINCT FROM (i.position_before + e.position_delta) OR i.target IS DISTINCT FROM i.position_after OR i.decision_seq >= i.execution_seq)) OR (i.execution_seq IS NULL AND (i.target IS DISTINCT FROM i.position_before OR i.position_after IS DISTINCT FROM i.position_before))) ORDER BY i.run_id LIMIT 1
